title: Why Malaysia Won’t Extradite Dr. Zakir Naik to India
gist: Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim's viral rendition of a Kishore Kumar Hindi film song at the BRICS Summit gala in New Delhi showcased warm cultural ties with India, framing an article on why Malaysia nonetheless won't extradite Islamic preacher Dr. Zakir Naik to India.

insights.claim: The most viral video of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi was not Narendra Modi shaking hands with Xi Jinping but Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim singing Kishore Kumar's Hindi song 'Khwaab Ho Tum Ya Koi Haqeeqat' at a gala dinner.
insights.speaker: Asif Ullah Khan
insights.so_what: Cultural warmth between Malaysia and India coexists with unresolved political disputes; do not over-read goodwill optics.

insights.claim: Indian movies are very popular in Malaysia, and Anwar Ibrahim has sung the same Bollywood song many times on past visits to India.
insights.speaker: Asif Ullah Khan
insights.so_what: Strong people-to-people and cultural ties underpin Malaysia-India relations beyond state-level friction.
